items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The deal went some way that Verve or whoever it was brought Wes and Creed Taylor together.

ctx.x: Creed Taylor was then with Verve as a producer.

Well, Verve...The deal went some way that Verve or whoever it was brought Wes and Creed Taylor together. Anyhow, whatever that was, the difference there was...OK...But I remember when I was working with Cal, Wes was telling me about it. You know, we always kept close, all of us, the brother did.

I'd be a phone call away. He was saying, 'Man, I went to make this thing at Riverside Records and, man, they really want to make me a solo guitarist.' I said, 'Oh, great, man. Jump and get it.'
